canonical_data: Relational database (H2/PostgreSQL/MySQL) for runtime, goal, and task state plus Markdown workspace-memory files (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, MEMORY.md)
current_repo_note: Repository created 2026-04-04 (about five months old) but already at v2.2.0 with roughly 1,500 commits; pushed as recently as 2026-09-12, indicating rapid, current development despite the short track record.
strengths: Pluggable Agent Runtime contract lets an employee run on a native StateGraph engine or an external DeepSeek Harness loop behind one session/tool/approval plane
Persistent Goals checkpoint and resume long tasks across backend restarts
RBAC, approval flows, Tool Guard, and a full audit trail target multi-user, enterprise deployment
Multi-vendor model failover with health tracking and cooldown avoids single-provider outages
LLM Wiki turns uploaded material into cited, cross-linked knowledge pages consumed automatically by employees
weaknesses: Repository is about five months old; breadth of enterprise claims (audit, multi-tenant RBAC) has no long production track record yet
Community is small relative to comparable runtimes (about 1,100 stars vs. tens of thousands for the OpenClaw project it explicitly benchmarks against)
No independent benchmark of the claimed failover/reliability behavior; evidence is vendor-authored README and docs
Very broad feature surface (runtime, memory, workflows, multi-channel messaging, content generation, wallets-adjacent business tooling) makes the operational boundary hard to audit end to end
why_it_matters: A fast-moving, enterprise-oriented alternative to single-user personal-agent runtimes, adding multi-user governance and a pluggable execution-engine contract on top of the same durable-agent pattern.
